nodes.label: BBTP Cognitive Test Battery
nodes.rationale: The collection is organised as one directory per neuropsychological paradigm (attention, inhibition, working memory, navigation) so tasks can be launched, linked into a study session, and compared as a battery rather than as separate apps.

nodes.label: PsychoJS 2025.1.1 Runtime Bundle
nodes.rationale: Pinned local copy (./lib/psychojs-2025.1.1.css + .js) instead of a CDN pin so every test in the battery runs on an identical, offline-capable engine version; jQuery/UI and preloadjs stay on pinned jsDelivr URLs.

nodes.label: PsychoPy Experiment Page Scaffold
nodes.rationale: Every task reuses one generated index.html shape: viewport meta with user-scalable=no, #root mount node, three external CDN libs, then a single type=module file named after the experiment. Uniformity comes from PsychoPy Builder export plus hand edits, which keeps a shared runner/launcher possible.

nodes.label: nomodule Legacy Browser Fallback
nodes.rationale: Some pages load lib/psychojs-2025.1.1.iife.js and a *-legacy-browsers.js twin script with nomodule so lab machines with older browsers (or file:// ES-module restrictions) can still run the task.
